QuestInfo.name: A Tailor in My Own Right!
QuestInfo.0: It seems #p303#, the tailor of #m10002000#, is finally ready to acknowledge my tailoring skills.
QuestInfo.1: #p303#, the tailor of #m10002000#, was impressed by how much I've grown and suggested I show off my abilities. I need to defeat #r#o22#s#k and craft #b1 #t1002084##k to bring back to him.
QuestInfo.2: #p303#, the tailor of #m10002000#, admired my craftsmanship and handed me a #t4130002#. It seems to be a special item that can alter an equipment's stats when used during crafting. Maybe I should give it a try.

0.0: I've heard rumors that you've become a proper tailor now... Naturally, I have to see for myself if they were true. You seem to have built up some skill and experience--care to prove it?

yes.0: Confident, are you? Hmph. Very well. Go defeat #r#o22#s#k near #m10004000# and craft #ba #t1002084##k, then bring it back. I'll be watching.

no.0: So, you haven't reached that level yet, have you? Hmph... perhaps this is the limit of a human after all.

1.0: Let's see... this is exceptionally well made. I didn't expect a human to reach this level of craftsmanship. Yes, this is more than sufficient to be called a true tailor. Your dedication to honing your skills is... admirable. Very well, this deserves a special reward.

yes.0: This #t4130002# is a special item that can alter an equipment's abilities when used during crafting. It's extremely delicate, so the results may disappoint you at times--but if handled properly, it could produce something beyond your expectations.
yes.1: If you wish to test the limits of your tailoring skills, I recommend using it. Continue your training, and don't grow complacent.

mob.0: It seems you haven't defeated all the monsters I mentioned. Go on, try to surpass the limits of your kind.

item.0: It seems you haven't gathered all the materials I asked for. Go on, try to surpass the limits of your kind.
